text_block_list.text:
On the day of her first Classic race, the
Satsuki
Sho, Голд Шипп is beside herself.
Apparently, she's
furious a race named
after May on the old
Japanese calendar
would take place in April.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In a wildly unexpected turn, Голд Шип
swears to
win the Satsuki Sho and
rename it "Uzuki Sho" for
April when she
does.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
